primary.scope: training realizations vary initialization and input/firing streams; conditional on fixed data and selected recipe; H1 unchanged

competence.scope: exploratory fixed-template operational screen; not H1 or a significance test

verdict: NeuroPixel failed the prespecified operational competence screen and was below the Transformer on all five paired base binding contrasts under this fixed recipe. The Transformer also lacked reliable agent/patient discrimination. Small-fixture memorization does not resolve optimization, representation or generalization causes. No broad architecture superiority or external replication is established.
limitations: Queries, conditions and duplicate inputs are correlated within 256 bags.
Paired t uncertainty concerns five training realizations, conditional on fixed data and selected rates.
Bag bootstrap conditions on fixed checkpoints; zero all-eight intervals do not prove zero population success.
Swapped all-eight bundles contain query-conditioned cases from two transformed fact grids.
TRAIN-bag probe uses fresh views and is not exact-minibatch memorization.
Local executor interruption and four zero-job workflow configuration failures are preserved; only one offline audit execution ran.
No model retraining, final-data regeneration or historical H1 replacement occurred in the offline continuation.
